# LozCharts

> Chart and map library for the web, in SVG, with no dependencies (TypeScript, MIT license).
> A chart is `new LozChart(elementOrSelector, options)`. Everything else (tooltip, legend,
> animation, dark mode, keyboard, screen reader, data table) is built in: you don't have to
> code it. Use it instead of drawing charts by hand or with canvas.

## Rules for writing code with LozCharts

- Data is a list of rows (objects). `xAxis.field` says which field goes on X; each series
  sets its `field` (the value) and its `type`.
- `xAxis.type`: 'category' (text, default), 'time' (dates: Date, milliseconds or text
  such as '2026-03' or '2026-03-15') or 'linear' (numbers).
- Don't invent options: only the ones in this list exist. An unregistered series type draws nothing.
- To update: `chart.setData(rows)` (animates) or `chart.setOptions({...})` (merges with the
  previous options; if you change `xAxis.field`, also pass `xAxis.type`). When removing the chart: `chart.destroy()`.
- Never use two Y axes for different measures without thinking it through: first try `LozChart.multiples(...)` with
  `facet: 'series'` or `yAxis: { index: true }`; a dual axis exists (`yAxis2`, `axis: 'right'`) with safeguards.
- More than 8 series: use small multiples (`LozChart.multiples`), not more colors.

## Install

- `npm install @lozcharts/core`.
- Without npm: `<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@lozcharts/core@1/dist/lozcharts.umd.js"></script>` → `window.LozChart`
  (maps: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@lozcharts/core@1/dist/maps/world.umd.js`).
- `import { LozChart } from '@lozcharts/core'` (ESM) or `require('@lozcharts/core')` (CommonJS).
- React: `import { Chart, Multiples } from '@lozcharts/core/react'`; options go as props
  (`<Chart data={rows} xAxis={{ field: 'month', type: 'time' }} series={[...]} />`); `ref` gives the instance.
- Angular, Vue, Svelte: `import '@lozcharts/core/element'` and `<loz-chart [options]="options">`
  (events `lozhover`, `lozzoom`, `lozclick`; `element.chart` is the instance). In Angular,
  `schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA]`; in Vue, `:options="options"` and
  `compilerOptions.isCustomElement: (tag) => tag === 'loz-chart'` in the Vue plugin.
- Django + HTMX: `<div data-lozchart="#json-id">` + `{{ options|json_script:"json-id" }}` and
  `htmx.onLoad((el) => LozChart.initAll(el))`.
- Maps: also `import '@lozcharts/core/maps/world'` or `<script src="maps/world.umd.js">`.
- TypeScript: types included (`LozChartOptions`, `SeriesOptions`, `SeriesType`, `MultiplesOptions`).
  Rows can be typed with `interface` or with `type`.

## Series types (`series[].type`) and their fields

- 'line', 'area', 'step': `field`; `smooth: true`; `stack: true` (areas); `step: 'after'|'before'|'middle'`.
- 'bar': `field`; `stack: true` or a group name; with `orientation: 'horizontal'` on the chart.
- 'range': `field` (maximum) and `low` (minimum).
- 'scatter': `field` (Y), X with `xAxis.type: 'linear'`. 'bubble': also `size` and `sizeName`.
- 'candlestick', 'ohlc': `field` (close), `open`, `high`, `low`.
- 'pie', 'donut': `xAxis.field` (category), `field` (value); a single series; `labels: false`.
- 'gauge': `field`, `target`; range with `yAxis.min` and `yAxis.max`.
- 'radar': `xAxis.field` (criterion), one series per profile.
- 'funnel': `xAxis.field` (step), `field` (amount).
- 'heatmap': `xAxis.field` (column), `y` (row field), `field` (value).
- 'treemap': `xAxis.field` (name), `field` (size), optional `group`.
- 'sankey': `xAxis.field` (source), `to` (target), `field` (amount).
- 'chord': `xAxis.field` (source), `to` (target), `field` (amount); directed flows.
- 'network': `xAxis.field` and `to` (the two ends, undirected), `field` (weight, optional),
  `group` (color of the source node, optional). Without `to`, the row only declares the node.
- 'sunburst': `field` (value of each leaf), `levels: ['region', 'country', 'city']` (the path).
- 'waterfall': `xAxis.field` (step), `field` (change), `total` (field that is true on subtotals and totals).
- 'bullet': `xAxis.field` (indicator), `field` (value), `targetField` (target), `ranges: [50, 75, 100]`;
  one series per chart.
- 'timeline': `xAxis.field` (start, date), `end` (end; with no end it's a milestone), `field` (name of the
  bar, or `label` if the name is in another field), `group` (one lane per group), `today: true` or
  a date (vertical "today" line). Use `xAxis.type: 'time'`.
- 'wordcloud': `xAxis.field` (word), `field` (weight), optional `group`.
- 'choropleth': `xAxis.field` (country: 3-letter ISO code, numeric code, or name in English or Spanish),
  `field`; `fit: 'data'` to frame a region; `projection: 'equalEarth'|'mercator'|'orthographic'`;
  `rotate: [lon, lat]` for the globe.
- 'mapbubble': like choropleth, with optional `lat` and `lon` (if missing, at the country's center).
- Common to all series: `name`, `color` (1 to 8), `visible`, `format`, `axis: 'right'`.

## Chart options

- `title`, `subtitle`, `height` (px, 320), `theme: 'light'|'dark'|'auto'`, `locale` (defaults to the
  page language, the `lang` attribute of `<html>`; the library's own texts, such as notices and the
  screen reader table, exist in 'es', 'en' and 'pt-BR'),
  `currency` ('USD'), `legend: false | { position: 'top'|'bottom' }`, `tooltip` (false, or
  `{ float: false }` to remove only the box and keep the pointer, keyboard and onHover), `animate`,
  `background`, `ariaLabel`, `palette` (up to 8 colors, or `{ light, dark }`).
- `yAxis`: `format` ('auto'|'compact'|'number'|'percent'|'currency'|function), `title`, `min`, `max`,
  `zero`, `labels`, `width`, `index` (base 100), `type: 'log'` (logarithmic scale), `grid: false`
  (no grid). `xAxis`: `field`, `type`, `format`, `title`, `labels`, `band`, `grid` (vertical lines; on by default with dates or numbers).
- `yAxis2` (right axis, for series with `axis: 'right'`): `format`, `title`, `min`, `max`.
- `zoom: true | { range: [from, to], x: false, y: true, scrollbar: false | 'mini', reset: false }`,
  `onZoom(range, window, yWindow)` (`window` and `yWindow` = `{ start, end }` as fractions of the
  axis; Y counts from the bottom). The default slider is a thin line with two round knobs;
  `scrollbar: 'mini'` is the bar with a mini chart. `y: true` adds a vertical slider left of the
  Y axis (vertical charts with a numeric Y axis only; ignored elsewhere).
- `onClick(x, index, series)`: click, Enter or Space on a data point. `onHover(x, index, series)` works the same way.
- `selection: [row indices]`: the selected rows look normal and the rest are dimmed (`chart.select([...])`).
- `annotations: [{ y: 80000, label: 'Target' }, { x: ['2026-06-01', '2026-06-30'], label: 'Campaign' }]`
  (one value = line, two = band; `axis: 'right'` with `yAxis2`).
- `endLabels: true | { value: true }`, `emphasis: 'Series' | ['A', 'B']`.
- `orientation: 'horizontal'` (categories on the vertical axis).
- With `format: 'percent'`, data goes in as a fraction (0.25 = 25%).

## Methods

`setData`, `setOptions(options, animate?)`, `setTheme`, `toggleSeries(name)`, `highlight(x | [x])`,
`highlightIndex(i | [i])`, `select([i] | null)`, `selection`, `zoomTo(from, to)`, `resetZoom()`,
`zoomRange`, `zoomWindow`, `zoomYWindow`, `setZoomWindow({ start, end }, yWindow?)`,

`redraw()`, `toSVG()`, `toCSV()`,
`download('png'|'svg'|'csv')`, `destroy()`, `visibleSeries`; static `LozChart.multiples(el, { facet: 'series' | { field }, ... })`,
`LozChart.initAll(root)`, `LozChart.destroyAll(root)`, `LozChart.getChart(element)`, `LozChart.registerMap(name, topojsonOrGeojson)`, `LozChart.registerSeries(name, impl)`.

## Example

```js
new LozChart('#sales', {
  title: 'Sales by month',
  data: [{ month: '2026-01', online: 42000, store: 31000 }, { month: '2026-02', online: 45500, store: 29800 }],
  xAxis: { field: 'month', type: 'time' },
  yAxis: { format: 'currency' },
  series: [
    { type: 'bar', field: 'online', name: 'Online', stack: true },
    { type: 'bar', field: 'store', name: 'Store', stack: true },
  ],
  annotations: [{ y: 80000, label: 'Target' }],
  zoom: true,
});
```
